answer: A random beacon audit plus a compute heartbeat blocks fake identities. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of identities; a picked agent must answer a challenge and send a heartbeat every 10 minutes, like a moving comet. A reef of copies cannot fake this: each copy needs its own session, and two missed heartbeats freeze it for 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 3,000 units, while an honest agent pays 3 units and keeps nectar-sweet rewards undiluted.
